# Blocked: <reason>

Unblocks when: <observable condition>

Status and priority belong in the Project.

## Problem and purpose

What problem or question does this story address, and why does it matter?

## Scope and non-goals

Describe the bounded work and the important exclusions.

## Context, constraints, and dependencies

Link the relevant current guidance and decisions. State constraints and the outcome needed from any prerequisite. Use native parent/sub-issue and blocked-by relationships rather than maintaining parallel lists here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An observable outcome that would satisfy this story.

<!-- For research, agree on the question, investigation limits, and required evidence before starting. A negative or inconclusive finding can satisfy those criteria; a favorable answer is not required. -->

## Verification plan

How will each acceptance criterion be checked, and what evidence will be retained? Record actual results and limitations in the linked PR or issue closeout; planned checks are not results.

## Lasting records

Which current guides, research records, or decision records should be created or updated? Explain if no repository documentation change is needed.

<!-- Keep significant scope/criteria changes, decisions, blockers, cancellation, and revival reasons in issue comments. Preserve earlier reasoning rather than silently replacing it. -->
